name: dbhub
description: Token-efficient database MCP server for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, and SQLite, with skills for connection setup and schema exploration

interface.longDescription: DBHub connects Codex to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, and SQLite through a minimal, token-efficient MCP server. Explore schemas with progressive disclosure and run read-only SQL, capped at 1000 rows.
defaultPrompt: Set up DBHub to connect to my database.
Explore the database schema and summarize the main tables.
